sample_unit: RCT abstracts (summaries) manually reviewed for accuracy

links.outcome: LLM RCT summary accuracy against manual review reference across extracted fields
links.effect: Accuracy with prompt engineering vs manual review: 97.1% study phase, 92.2% blinding, 85.4% sample size, 97.9% population, 94.7% comparison groups, 92.7% primary outcome.
links.quote: The accuracy for reporting study information with prompt engineering, compared to manual review, was 97.1% for study phase, 92.2% for blinding, 85.4% for sample size, 97.9% for patient population, 94.7% for comparison groups, and 92.7% for primary outcome.

unlisted_practices: prompt engineering to improve LLM extraction accuracy of trial abstract information
marketing strategies for newsletter subscriber growth

screen.reason: Prospective deployment and evaluation of an LLM-generated newsletter summarizing clinical trials for clinicians, evaluating extraction accuracy and subscriber satisfaction.
